policy_notes.title: NIL Go's latest clearinghouse report (Sept. 9)
policy_notes.body: Per the College Sports Commission's updated report as covered by On3, Yahoo Sports, and the AP: 7,639 deals worth $227.25M cleared from July 1–Aug. 31 — the largest two-month total since launch; 484 deals worth $67.08M were not cleared, one in arbitration. Cumulatively, roughly 46,478 deals worth $582.49M cleared over ~14 months. (Earlier figures like the inaugural report's $35.42M describe earlier periods, not this one.)

policy_notes.title: SEC moves against pro-returnees; LSU expulsion filing (Sept. 8)
policy_notes.body: The SEC moved to bar former pro athletes from returning to college rosters (following the Big Ten's football-only rule), and on Sept. 8 filed an amended federal complaint (N.D. Ala.) against LSU seeking authority to expel the school by a two-thirds presidential vote, with a Sept. 10 committee meeting scheduled. Expulsion is widely characterized as a nuclear option not expected to be executed.

policy_notes.title: NCAA will not overturn Michigan-Western Michigan (Sept. 8)
policy_notes.body: The NCAA, with the FBS Oversight Committee, declared it has no authority to overturn a completed game's result — a score is final once the referee ends the game — rejecting the MAC's appeal to award Western Michigan a win over Michigan (13-12, decided on a restored-clock Hail Mary).

policy_notes.title: Protect College Sports Act momentum
policy_notes.body: The Senate's cloture vote on S. 4668 (Cruz-Cantwell) is expected between Sept. 15-23. Deion Sanders appears in the campaign's latest 'Primetime' ad, following a Week 1 Nick Saban spot; the ad buy is roughly $5-6M per Politico via On3, primarily funded by a Texas Tech booster.

valuation_methodology: On3 moved from an algorithmic model to a deal-based valuation on July 1, 2026 — figures reflect current college/collective contract value, not projected marketing power, and are not comparable to pre-2026 numbers. On3 is a single proprietary source, so every valuation is capped at medium confidence unless a second named outlet publishes the identical figure.
